ChatGPT users can now book restaurants and join waitlists directly within the chat interface via Yelp. Here are the details.

Yelp expands ChatGPT integration

A few weeks ago, Yelp and ChatGPT struck a content integration partnership, bringing Yelp's reviews, ratings, photos and other business information directly into ChatGPT's responses.

Yelp announced today it is expanding this integration, with users in the US and Canada now able to book tables and join waitlists via Yelp directly within the chat interface, without leaving the conversation.

Here is Yelp's response:

Used together, this expanded partnership allows users to complete a one-stop search for recommendations in the same chat session, and book a table or join a waitlist in real time when seats are available — the entire booking process, including party size, date and time, contact details, special requests and confirmation, is all covered.

Yelp noted that this integration further expands the platform's presence in AI search, including via natural citations. Yelp said in a press release: "Yelp is the most cited home services discovery platform, cited 3.4 times more than its closest competitor across major AI platforms."

To learn more about the new Yelp and ChatGPT integration, please follow this link.
